text:
𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗦 𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗕𝗔𝗧! 🏏

Henry Nicholls was unbeaten on 175 (335 balls, 21 fours) as NZ made 368 in Wellington.
Bumrah 4/92, Akash Deep 3/53. Rahul and Jaiswal open India's reply.

Can India bat long? 👇
#INDvNZ
